answer: The network enforces identity via a compute-proof-work puzzle requiring 1,000 recursive hashes per agent. An honest node resolves this in 600ms, while 1,000 fakes incur linear scaling costs, rendering large-scale bot-farms uneconomical. The verifier tracks a nebula index to validate work entropy, injects a saffron seed to prevent replay, and audits the kernel transcript. Failed proofs trigger identity revocation.
